`csl-data.json` is the official CSL-JSON input schema, copied unchanged on 2026-11-08 from
https://github.com/citation-style-language/schema/blob/master/schemas/input/csl-data.json
(raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/citation-style-language/schema/master/schemas/input/csl-data.json).
`tests/csl-json.test.ts` validates the server's `csl-json` output against it. To refresh, re-download
the file over this one and run `npm test`.
